$comment: THE PERMISSION GATE FOR THE LANDING FIELD (build spec §1).
Every logo shown on this site requires written permission from the company.
A mark with kind 'logo' is only rendered when BOTH approvedBy and approvedOn
are present — lib/marks.ts drops any that are not and says so in the build
log. Nothing reaches the page by being dropped into /public.
Until permissions land the field floats abstract glyphs. They carry no
meaning on purpose: the page argues by showing, so it must not float words.
1. Put a monochrome SVG at /public/marks/<company>.svg (single path, no
embedded colour — it is recoloured to the foreground token).
3. Delete one glyph so the field density stays the same.
The same asset pool serves the alumni dossiers' venture marks.
